data.title: Oral Sentence Studio
data.description: Look at the picture, listen, and say it in your own words.

challenges.situation: Bunny has a sweet cookie and thinks everyone loves them.
challenges.claim: Bunny says cookies are the best treat in the whole world.
examples: Yes, I agree because cookies taste very sweet.
No, I disagree because I like fruit more.
No, I disagree because cookies can be crumbly.

challenges.situation: Frog holds a bright kite on a windy afternoon.
challenges.claim: Frog says flying kites is the most fun game to play.
examples: Yes, I agree because kites fly high in the sky.
No, I disagree because playing tag is more fun.
Yes, I agree because the wind feels nice.

challenges.situation: Cat looks closely at a fuzzy blue shoe.
challenges.claim: Cat says shoes are the best toys to chase around.
examples: No, I disagree because shoes go on our feet.
Yes, I agree because they roll when you push them.
No, I disagree because balls are better toys.
